He co-founded MetaMask in 2016 with Aaron Davis while working at ConsenSys, a blockchain software company. MetaMask became one of the most widely used Web3 wallets, enabling users to interact with the Ethereum blockchain through browser extensions and mobile apps.

Finlay has been an advocate for decentralized technologies, user privacy, and open-source development in the blockchain space. He has spoken publicly about challenges in crypto UX, security, and the evolution of Web3 infrastructure.

I am less certain about his specific roles prior to MetaMask or his current activities beyond general industry involvement.
